name: nexus
description: Review your team, delegate work and retrieve durable results in Nexus.

interface.shortDescription: Your persistent team behind your assistant.
interface.longDescription: Use your Nexus team as yourself. Review tasks, delegate work to agents, add feedback and retrieve documents. Delegation can start autonomous work using your team's configured execution capacity and budget.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my Nexus team and show what needs my attention.
